title: Seasonal Variation and Components
author: 696637e49d26457b33c7eff3
chapter_outcomes: Plot data to form a time series graph.
Understand the reasons for finding moving averages.
Calculate and plot moving average values. May include centring. Understand when centring is appropriate.
Understand trend and draw a trend line by eye using moving average values.

Understand seasonal variation and calculate seasonal components. Calculation of seasonal components (average seasonal variation): from tables of data values and moving average values, from time series graphs and trend lines.
Use a trend line and seasonal component to make predictions and understand assumptions made and limitations of the process.
